mapper.select: SELECT M.LINE_PRESET_ID, M.USER_ID, M.PRESET_NM, M.CO_CD, M.SORT_NO, M.USE_YN, TO_CHAR(M.CREAT_DTTM, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREAT_DTTM FROM TB_AM03M01 M WHERE M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY M.SORT_NO ASC, M.PRESET_NM ASC

SELECT M.LINE_PRESET_ID, M.PRESET_NM, M.USE_YN, D.LINE_SEQ, D.APPR_TYPE, FN_CM05M01_CD_TO_NM(D.APPR_TYPE) AS APPR_TYPE_NM, D.APPR_USER_ID, NVL(U.NAME, D.APPR_USER_ID) AS APPR_USER_NM, D.APPR_DEPT_ID, NVL(DEP.DEPT_NM, D.APPR_DEPT_ID) AS APPR_DEPT_NM, U.LEVEL_CD, L.LEVEL_NM FROM TB_AM03M01 M LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_AM03D01 D ON M.LINE_PRESET_ID = D.LINE_PRESET_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM06M01 U ON D.APPR_USER_ID = U.ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM04M01 DEP ON D.APPR_DEPT_ID = DEP.DEPT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM07M01 L ON U.LEVEL_CD = L.LEVEL_CD WHERE M.LINE_PRESET_ID = #{linePresetId} ORDER BY D.LINE_SEQ ASC
mapper.insert:
SELECT TO_CHAR(TB_AM03M01_SQ01.NEXTVAL) FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_AM03M01 ( LINE_PRESET_ID, USER_ID, PRESET_NM, CO_CD, SORT_NO, USE_YN, CREAT_ID, CREAT_PGM, CREAT_DTTM, UDT_ID, UDT_PGM, UDT_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{linePresetId}, #{userId}, #{presetNm}, #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{sortNo, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 1), 'Y', #{userId}, #{pgmId}, SYSDATE, #{userId}, #{pgmId}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO TB_AM03D01 ( LINE_PRESET_ID, LINE_SEQ, APPR_TYPE, APPR_USER_ID, APPR_DEPT_ID, SORT_NO, CREAT_ID, CREAT_PGM, CREAT_DTTM, UDT_ID, UDT_PGM, UDT_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{linePresetId}, #{lineSeq}, #{apprType}, #{apprUserId}, #{apprDeptId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lineSeq}, #{userId}, #{pgmId}, SYSDATE, #{userId}, #{pgmId}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT G.DELEGATE_ID, G.ORIGIN_USER_ID, U1.NAME AS ORIGIN_USER_NM, G.DELEGATE_USER_ID, U2.NAME AS DELEGATE_USER_NM, D2.DEPT_NM AS DELEGATE_DEPT_NM, L2.LEVEL_NM AS DELEGATE_LEVEL_NM, G.START_DT, G.END_DT, G.DELEGATE_RSN, G.USE_YN, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN G.START_DT AND G.END_DT AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' THEN '진행중' WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') < G.START_DT AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' THEN '예정' ELSE '종료' END AS STATUS_NM FROM TB_AM03M02 G LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM06M01 U1 ON G.ORIGIN_USER_ID = U1.ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM06M01 U2 ON G.DELEGATE_USER_ID = U2.ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM04M01 D2 ON U2.DEPT_ID = D2.DEPT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CM07M01 L2 ON U2.LEVEL_CD = L2.LEVEL_CD WHERE G.ORIGIN_USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY G.START_DT DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(TB_AM03M02_SQ01.NEXTVAL) FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_AM03M02 ( DELEGATE_ID, ORIGIN_USER_ID, DELEGATE_USER_ID, START_DT, END_DT, DELEGATE_RSN, USE_YN, CO_CD, CREAT_ID, CREAT_PGM, CREAT_DTTM, UDT_ID, UDT_PGM, UDT_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{delegateId}, #{userId}, #{delegateUserId}, REPLACE(#{startDt}, '-', ''), REPLACE(#{endDt}, '-', ''), #{delegateRsn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), #{coCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId}, #{pgmId}, SYSDATE, #{userId}, #{pgmId}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_AM03M02 SET USE_YN = #{useYn}, UDT_ID = #{userId}, UDT_PGM = #{pgmId}, UDT_DTTM = SYSDATE WHERE DELEGATE_ID = #{delegateId} AND ORIGIN_USER_ID = #{userId}
